messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-gpu-runtime prod us-west-2 — alert=GPU_ALLOC_FAILURE (rate=7/min)

pagerduty: Triggered on-call rotation: @alex (primary) — incident severity: P1 — link: https://pd.example/INC12345

alex: acked — I'm on it. collecting initial context now. /sentry and /metrics show a spike in cudaMalloc failures across model-worker-8xx in us-west-2.

miguel: seeing same. k8s node gpu-uw2-23 has repeated OOM-ish stacktraces: `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` but GPU memory usage reported ~88% not 100%. could be fragmentation or allocator failure.

alex: copying logs — here's a short excerpt: ```
[2024-12-11T03:12:21Z] model-worker-861 libcudart: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (error 2)
[2024-12-11T03:12:21Z] model-worker-861 runtime: failed to reserve device buffer size=3.2GB
[2024-12-11T03:12:22Z] model-worker-861 trace: kvcache-alloc attempt=1 free=120MB
[2024-12-11T03:12:23Z] model-worker-861 supervisor: restart worker (oom-protection)
```

ops-bot: Auto-shed policy kicked: low-priority queues paused in us-west-2, draining batch jobs. batch-queue reductions: 12 -> 2 workers.

sana: @alex any customer-facing impact yet?

alex: initial look — most realtime endpoints still responding, a handful of long-running embedding jobs got 503 from dedicated pools. support alerted one customer (acme-ai). They reported increased latency ~> 20s for embeddings around 03:10-03:16 UTC.

miguel: quick mitigation idea: trigger rolling-restart on model-worker pool with nodeSelector gpu-type:ampere-lowfrag to force reallocation and clear stale allocations. also bump mem-overcommit for the pool to tolerate temporary spikes.

alex: running namespace-level cordon/drain on gpu-uw2-23 to move pods off suspected node. command: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-uw2-23 -n prod
kubectl drain gpu-uw2-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n prod --force
```

miguel: good. I'm also flipping kvcache eviction threshold to 0.6 to free prefix caches: `POST /admin/kvcache?action=set_threshold&value=0.6`

incident-bot: Auto-escalation threshold reached (10m no resolution) — paging escalation to secondary on-call: @sana.

sana: taking over for escalation, thanks. quick status?

alex: cordon+drain started, 3 pods rescheduled to other nodes. ops-bot reports model-worker-861 restarted successfully but we still see sporadic cudaMalloc errors on two new workers.

miguel: logs point to CUDA driver warnings right before failures: `NVRM: Xid 79` messages. adding driver-check task.

alex: temporary customer mitigation — routing policy adjusted to avoid dedicated pool in us-west-2 for embeddings; fallback to hosted pool with soft-limits. This should reduce failures visible to customers.

sana: noted. please file a customer-facing incident note for ACME: explain latencies and mitigation we applied; support should offer retry/backoff guidance.

alex: writing quick post to support: "We observed GPU allocation failures in us-west-2 affecting embedding jobs from 03:10-03:18 UTC. We cordoned a node and drained impacted pods, started eviction and cache tuning, and shifted routing to alternate pools. We are continuing to monitor; no persistent data loss. We will follow up with root cause once driver/allocator traces are in."

miguel: running nvml/driver probe across cluster and collecting /var/log/nvidia-installer and dmesg. uploading artifacts to incident channel.

ops-bot: autoscaler adjusted: increased dedicated fallback capacity in us-west-2 by 2 nodes (on-demand).

alex: can someone take a look at model-loader's memory fragmentation metrics? I suspect pooled allocator fragmentation — marking for postmortem.

sana: i'll pick up on caller communications. alex, miguel please paste any relevant kernel/xid traces into the incident doc. i'll handle escalation and followup with support.

miguel: pasted nvml excerpts and `nvidia-smi -q` snapshots to /incidents/INC12345/artifacts. key Xid entries: ```
Dec 11 03:11:58 gpu-uw2-23 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Dec 11 03:12:19 gpu-uw2-23 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 33, Cuda OOM or similar.
```

alex: ok — for now primary mitigation steps: 1) cordon+drain suspect node 2) lower kvcache threshold 3) shift routing for embeddings -> hosted fallback 4) increase dedicated fallback nodes. Monitoring shows error rate down from 7/min to ~1/min after actions.

sana: thanks. i'll record handoff: @alex you're handing to me at 03:40 UTC for follow-up and postmortem. please make sure the incident doc has the timeline + artifacts.

alex: handing off to @sana. leaving notes in INC12345. if error rate rises above 3/min, please escalate to infra eng.

incident-bot: Incident marked: handed_off_to_secondary — responders: alex (primary), sana (secondary), miguel (on-call assist).

sana: acknowledged handoff. will run a longer RCA with infra/driver team tomorrow. closing on-call thread for immediate operators. :white_check_mark:
